'''Brodric Thomas''' (born January 28, 1997) is an American professional [[basketball]] player who last played for [[Manisa Basket]] of the [[Basketbol Süper Ligi]] (BSL). He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Truman State Bulldogs]].

==High school and college career==
Thomas attended [[Bolingbrook High School]] in Illinois where he played basketball. At Bolingbrook, he "played second or third fiddle" to teammates who went on to play for [[NCAA Division I]] schools. As a result, he received comparatively less attention from [[college basketball]] recruiters.<ref name="surprise" />

Thomas committed to play college basketball in [[NCAA Division II]] for the [[Truman State Bulldogs]]. Before his freshman year, he suffered an injury which forced him to [[redshirt (sports)|redshirt]].<ref name="surprise">{{cite news|first=Austin|last=Miller|title='It's a surprise that he's even here': A look at how and why Brodric Thomas excelled at Truman|url=https://www.kirksvilledailyexpress.com/sports/20200319/its-surprise-that-hes-even-here-look-at-how-and-why-brodric-thomas-excelled-at-truman|work=[[Kirksville Daily Express]]|date=March 19, 2020|access-date=14 May 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210514022300/https://www.kirksvilledailyexpress.com/sports/20200319/its-surprise-that-hes-even-here-look-at-how-and-why-brodric-thomas-excelled-at-truman|archive-date=May 14, 2021|url-status=live}}</ref> In the meantime, his grades suffered and he transferred to [[Southwestern Community College (Iowa)|Southwestern Community College]] where he grew four inches, added fifty pounds, won a [[NJCAA Men's Division II Basketball Championship]], was named the MVP of that tournament, was First Team All-[[Iowa Community College Athletic Conference]], was named Second-Team All-American and attracted the attention of NCAA Division I recruiters.<ref name="surprise" /><ref name="returns">{{cite news|first=Jamie|last=Fowle|title=Thomas Returns to Bulldogs as Champion|url=https://tmn.truman.edu/blog/sports/thomas-returns-to-bulldogs-as-champion/|work=Truman Media Network|publisher=[[Truman State University]]|date=November 15, 2017|access-date=May 14, 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220205065112/https://tmn.truman.edu/blog/sports/thomas-returns-to-bulldogs-as-champion/|archive-date=February 5, 2022|url-status=live}}</ref>

However, he ultimately decided to return to Truman. He played three seasons for the Bulldogs.<ref name="bulldogs">{{cite web|title=Brodric Thomas - Men's Basketball|url=https://trumanbulldogs.com/sports/mens-basketball/roster/brodric-thomas/4865|work=[[Truman Bulldogs|Truman State University Athletics]]|access-date=May 14, 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210129234359/https://trumanbulldogs.com/sports/mens-basketball/roster/brodric-thomas/4865|archive-date=January 29, 2021|url-status=live}}</ref> As a senior, he was named the [[Great Lakes Valley Conference]] Player of the Year and scored a school record 666 points.<ref>{{cite news|first=Austin|last=Miller|title=Former Truman star Brodric Thomas selected for Professional Basketball Combine|url=https://www.kirksvilledailyexpress.com/story/sports/college/basketball/2020/10/01/former-truman-star-brodric-thomas-selected-for-professional-basketball-combine/114200398/|work=[[Kirksville Daily Express]]|date=October 1, 2020|access-date=May 14, 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210515040607/https://www.kirksvilledailyexpress.com/story/sports/college/basketball/2020/10/01/former-truman-star-brodric-thomas-selected-for-professional-basketball-combine/114200398/|archive-date=May 15, 2021|url-status=live}}</ref>

==Professional career==
===Houston Rockets (2020–2021)===
After going undrafted in the [[2020 NBA draft]], Thomas signed with the [[Houston Rockets]]. His contract was converted to a [[two-way contract]] at the end of training camp.

He made his NBA debut on December 26, 2020, in [[Portland, Oregon|Portland]] at the [[Moda Center]].<ref name="bkref">{{cite web|title=Brodric Thomas Stats|url=https://www.basketball-reference.com/players/t/thomabr01.html|website=Basketball-Reference.com|publisher=[[Sports Reference]]|access-date=May 13, 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220204105744/https://www.basketball-reference.com/players/t/thomabr01.html|archive-date=February 4, 2022|url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|title=Houston Rockets at Portland Trail Blazers Box Score, December 26, 2020|url=https://www.basketball-reference.com/boxscores/202012260POR.html|website=Basketball-Reference.com|publisher=[[Sports Reference]]|access-date=May 13, 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211026092852/https://www.basketball-reference.com/boxscores/202012260POR.html|archive-date=October 26, 2021|url-status=live}}</ref> On February 12, 2021, Thomas was waived by the Rockets.<ref>{{cite web|title=Rockets Sign Ray Spalding to Two-Way Contract|url=https://www.nba.com/rockets/news/rockets-sign-ray-spalding-two-way-contract|date=February 12, 2021|website=NBA.com|access-date=February 12, 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210608111841/https://www.nba.com/rockets/news/rockets-sign-ray-spalding-two-way-contract|archive-date=June 8, 2021|url-status=live}}</ref> He had totaled ten points in 24 minutes over four games with the Rockets.<ref name="bkref" />

===Rio Grande Valley Vipers (2021)===
On February 14, 2021, the [[Rio Grande Valley Vipers]] announced that they had signed Thomas.<ref>{{cite web|title=Vipers sign Brodric Thomas.|url=https://twitter.com/RGVVipers/status/1361120452559704064|date=February 15, 2021|work=RGV Vipers on Twitter.com|access-date=February 15, 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210215010953/https://twitter.com/RGVVipers/status/1361120452559704064|archive-date=February 15, 2021|url-status=live}}</ref>

===Cleveland Cavaliers (2021)===
[[File:Brodric Thomas (51177095574) (cropped).jpg|thumb|right|Thomas with the [[Cleveland Cavaliers]] in 2021]]
On February 24, 2021, Thomas was signed by [[Cleveland Cavaliers]] to a [[two-way contract]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Cavaliers Waive Marques Bolden, Sign Brodric Thomas to Two-Way Contract|url=https://www.nba.com/cavaliers/releases/thomas-two-way-210224|website=NBA.com|date=February 24, 2021|access-date=February 24, 2021|archive-date=June 8, 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210608111840/https://www.nba.com/cavaliers/releases/thomas-two-way-210224|url-status=live}}</ref> He was re-signed on September 15,<ref>{{cite web|title=Cavaliers Re-Sign Brodric Thomas to Two-Way Contract|url=https://www.nba.com/cavaliers/releases/thomas-signing-210915|website=NBA.com|date=September 15, 2021|access-date=September 15, 2021}}</ref> but was later waived on October 12.<ref>{{cite web|title=Cavaliers Waive Two Players|url=https://www.nba.com/cavaliers/releases/roster-update-211012|website=NBA.com|date=October 12, 2021|access-date=October 18, 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211019061240/https://www.nba.com/cavaliers/releases/roster-update-211012|archive-date=October 19, 2021|url-status=live}}</ref>

===Boston Celtics (2021–2022)===
On October 18, 2021, Thomas signed a two-way deal with the [[Boston Celtics]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Celtics Sign Brodric Thomas to Two-Way Contract|url=https://www.nba.com/celtics/news/pressrelease/celtics-sign-brodric-thomas-two-way-contract|website=NBA.com|date=October 18, 2021|access-date=October 18, 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211018165210/https://www.nba.com/celtics/news/pressrelease/celtics-sign-brodric-thomas-two-way-contract|archive-date=October 18, 2021|url-status=live}}</ref> The Celtics reached the [[2022 NBA Finals]], where they were defeated by the [[Golden State Warriors]] in 6 games. He re-signed with the Celtics on September 23, 2022.<ref>{{cite web|title=Celtics' Brodric Thomas: Inks deal with Boston|url=https://www.cbssports.com/fantasy/basketball/news/celtics-brodric-thomas-inks-deal-with-boston/amp/|website=CBSSports.com|date=September 23, 2022|access-date=October 3, 2022}}</ref> He was waived on October 12, 2022.<ref>{{cite web|title=Report: Celtics waive Brodric Thomas|url=https://www.nbcsports.com/boston/celtics/nba-rumors-celtics-waive-guard-brodric-thomas|website=CBSSports.com|date=October 12, 2022|access-date=October 12, 2022}}</ref>

===Ontario Clippers (2023–2024)===
On October 2, 2023, Thomas signed with the [[Los Angeles Clippers]],<ref>{{cite tweet|first=Justin|last=W.|title=Official training camp roster  for 23’-24’|number=1708875925163847978|user=LAClippersFilm|date=October 2, 2023|access-date=October 3, 2023}}</ref> but was waived on October 9.<ref>{{cite web|first=Dana|last=Gauruder|title=Clippers Waive Brodric Thomas, Sign Nate Darling|url=https://www.hoopsrumors.com/2023/10/clippers-to-waive-thomas-sign-darling.html|work=HoopsRumors.com|date=October 9, 2023|access-date=October 10, 2023}}</ref> On October 30, Thomas joined the [[San Diego Clippers (NBA G League)|Ontario Clippers]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Ontario Clippers Announce Training Camp Roster for 2023-24 NBA G League Season|url=https://www.hoopsrumors.com/2024/09/clippers-to-sign-elijah-harkless-to-exhibit-10-contract.html|website=OurSportsCentral.com|date=October 30, 2023|access-date=September 14, 2024}}</ref>

On September 28, 2024, Thomas signed with the [[Sacramento Kings]],<ref>{{cite web|title=Kings Sign Brodric Thomas|url=https://www.nba.com/kings/news/kings-sign-brodric-thomas|website=NBA.com|date=September 28, 2024|access-date=September 28, 2024}}</ref> but was waived on October 18.<ref>{{cite web|title=Kings Announce Roster Moves|url=https://www.nba.com/kings/news/kings-announce-roster-moves-2|website=NBA.com|date=October 18, 2024|access-date=October 20, 2024}}</ref>

===Manisa Basket (2024–2025)===
On November 16, 2024, Thomas signed with [[Manisa Basket]] of the [[Basketbol Süper Ligi]] (BSL).<ref>{{cite tweet|author=Manisa Basket|title=Brodric Thomas Manisa Basket’te! 27 yaşında, kısa forvet ve şutör guard pozisyonlarında görev yapan Thomas, takımımıza katıldı!|number=1857913508043624633|user=manisabasket94|date=November 16, 2024|access-date=November 17, 2024|language=Turkish}}</ref>

On July 8, 2025, he signed with [[Fighting Eagles Nagoya]] of the [[B.League]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.fightingeagles.jp/news/detail/id=17147|title=ブロドリック・トーマス 選手 契約(新規)のお知らせ|date=July 8, 2025|website=fightingeagles.jp|publisher=|language=ja|access-date=July 9, 2025}}</ref> On July 23, his contract was terminated.<ref>{{cite web |title=【#8 ブロドリック・トーマス 選手】契約解除のお知らせ |url=https://www.fightingeagles.jp/news/detail/id=17176 |website=ファイティングイーグルス名古屋 |access-date=21 August 2025 |date=23 July 2025}}</ref>

==Personal life==
Thomas majored in [[psychology]] in college.<ref name="bulldogs" />
